title: cuicui.preset
description: A Syrinx preset: parameter values by registry ID. Loading a preset sets every listed parameter to its value and every other parameter to its default. Values are in the parameter's own units; choices may be given by name (preferred) or by index, switches by true/false or 0/1. Unknown parameter IDs are ignored. WP-R4, decision D-028.

voice_bank.description: Name of the syllable bank the preset was made with (e.g. zf_22938).
